title.en: An Act Providing Minimum Compensation for Certain Members of the City Police Force of the City of Cebu, Amending for the Purpose Section Thirty-Five of Commonwealth Act Numbered Fifty-Eight
title.orig: An Act Providing Minimum Compensation for Certain Members of the City Police Force of the City of Cebu, Amending for the Purpose Section Thirty-Five of Commonwealth Act Numbered Fifty-Eight

text.en:
Section thirty-five of Commonwealth Act Numbered Fifty-eight is amended by adding at the end thereof the following new paragraph:
"The following members of the City Police Force shall receive minimum compensation at the following rates:
"Patrolmen and Patrolmen Detectives ₱2,160.00 per annum "Corporals and Corporal Detectives 2,280.00 per annum "Sergeants and Sergeant Detectives 2,400.00 per annum

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1961.
